enchantment.alchemy.turn_stone_into_gold: With Silk Touch, mining stone or cobblestone has a chance to turn the drop into an ore block (deepslate variants when mining deepslate).
enchantment.alchemy.mini_protection.desc: Reduces incoming damage by a flat 0.5 per level. Levels on all four armor pieces add up, and it stacks with Protection and other vanilla protection enchantments.
enchantment.alchemy.double_strike.desc: Landing a sword hit immediately deals a second hit for 50% of the original damage, ignoring the target's invulnerability frames. Each trigger costs double durability.
death.attack.double_strike.item: %1$s was slain by %2$s's double strike using %3$s
